title: DataWiz AI: asking your data questions in natural language
excerpt: Enterprise conversational AI removes the dependence on technical teams to get answers about projects, contracts and budget execution.
content:
Enterprise conversational AI removes the dependence on technical teams to get answers about projects, contracts and budget execution.

The invisible bottleneck

In almost every entity, there are two or three people who know how to build the right query. Every relevant question goes through them. It's not a talent problem; it's a structural bottleneck that slows down every decision.

What DataWiz does

It securely connects the organization's structured and unstructured data with advanced natural language models, so any authorized person can ask questions without technical knowledge and get answers as text, tables or charts.

[KPI] 500M::Tokens of scalability | 50K::Monthly queries | 99.5%::Uptime (SLA)

Security first

  • Granular RBAC/ABAC control: each user can only query what they're authorized to see.
  • TLS 1.3 encryption in transit and AES-256 at rest.
  • Your data is not used to train public models.
  • Enterprise models via API, with the option to integrate other providers.

Asking the right question no longer requires knowing SQL. It requires knowing what you want to understand.

COBRA AI

The same engine, built directly into COBRA Corporate and applied to the project, contract and execution data the platform already manages.
